title: LIVE | Ex-Anthropic researcher Coxon who warned AI could ‘kill us all’ testifies at NY City Council
description: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon is testifying before the New York City Council on the risks of rapidly advancing artificial intelligence. Coxon has warned that AI could become too powerful for humans to control, raising fears over AI safety, superintelligence and catastrophic risks. The NYC AI hearing examines tougher safeguards, human “kill switches,” whistleblower protections and regulation as lawmakers question major AI companies.
